paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 2.61 as of October 30, 2026, with a change of -8.74% from the prior close and -38% over a window of 23 sessions.

Recent news includes an article from Construction Review about Project Matador, an 11-gigawatt power campus in Amarillo, Texas, being developed by Fermi to supply power to AI data centers. Other news sources such as MarketBeat and Yahoo Finance have reported on the stock's price movements and whether the current level is a bargain following a sharp selloff.

There have been recent filings, including 4 Form 4 and 3 Form 144 filings, with the most recent being an insider transaction report on October 22, 2026, and a notice of proposed sale on October 20, 2026. An 8-K filing on October 16, 2026, announced an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
